run_transformer_text_generation: run the PackedCausalTransformerGenerator to generate text from prompts using a loaded LMTransformer checkpoint
sample_tokens_with_top_p: sample tokens from logits using top-p nucleus sampling with configurable temperature and probability threshold
sample_tokens_with_top_k: sample tokens from logits using top-k sampling with configurable temperature and k value
pack_prompts_for_batching: pack multiple tokenized prompts into a single concatenated tensor with their corresponding lengths
load_consolidated_model_and_tokenizer: load a consolidated LMTransformer model and tokenizer from a checkpoint directory with params.json config
